barriers.impact: Users navigating with keyboard or assistive technology cannot properly interact with nav > ul > li:nth-of-type(1) > a: No outline, box-shadow, border or background change detected when element is focused. tag=a, role=a.

fix.body: nav > ul > li:nth-of-type(1) > a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2563eb !important; outline-offset: 2px !important; }
fix.rationale: Restores a high-contrast focus indicator satisfying WCAG 2.4.7.

barriers.verificationEvidence: Chromium keyboard re-crawl confirmed barrier eliminated with 0 regressions.
